title: SamplingPolicy
description: How an engine selects variants from a space (spec.md §3.8). Resolved in layers — specification defaults, session config, interaction spec, per-call override — with every member overriding, except 'pin' and 'exclude' which accumulate.

strategy.description: Default 'auto': exhaustive at or below 'exhaustive-threshold', t-wise above it (spec.md §3.2).

strength.description: Covering strength for 't-wise'. 2 is pairwise, the default.

exhaustive-threshold.description: Space size at or below which 'auto' selects every variant.

max-variants.description: Largest selection the engine will return for one interaction. Exceeding it is 'variant-budget-exceeded', never a truncated selection (spec.md §3.6).

boundaries.description: Seed the minimal and maximal variants — every ordered-facet dimension at its lowest and highest point, the rest at their defaults (spec.md §3.1). They cost between zero and two variants, because the covering step works around a seed.

pin.description: Partial assignments the selection must extend, in order, after the base variant.

exclude.description: Regions removed from the space: never selected, never a coverage target, always reported with their reason (spec.md §3.5).

Pin.title: Pin
Pin.description: A partial assignment. The sampler completes it with defaults and includes the result.

Exclusion.title: Exclusion
Exclusion.description: A conjunction of points that cannot occur together. A list of pairs, never an expression (spec.md §3.5).

reason.description: Required: an excluded region is declared width that will never be demonstrated, and the contract records why.

PointRef.title: PointRef
PointRef.description: A dimension reference (full id, full path, or a trailing run of whole path segments — spec.md §6.3) bound to one of its points.
